source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Innovative Application Design (PDF 116, printed 112).

blocks.text: Emerging technologies se application banana ek haqeeqi masla pehchanne aur use hal karne ke liye tools ka sahi milap chunne se shuru hota hai. Maslan AI zaheen tutoring systems ke liye, IoT smart shehar ke intizam ke liye, Cloud mehfooz data access ke liye, aur Blockchain records ki tasdeeq (authentication) ke liye use ho sakta hai. Talaba ko aise khayalat sochne (brainstorm) ki targheeb di jati hai jo seedha Pakistan ki samaji aur maashi zarooraton ko hal karein.

Nayi ijaad tab phalti phoolti hai jab takhleeqi soch kisi maqsad se mil jaye. Talaba design-thinking ke tareeqe use kar ke maqami halat ke mutabiq, user ki zaroorat par mabni amli hal bana sakte hain. Pani ke intizam, traffic control ya taleem tak rasai jaise masail par projects tanqeedi soch (critical thinking) barhate aur bastiyon ki tarakki mein musbat hissa dalte hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Kaghaz par ya digital tareeqe se ek saadi app ki screen (interface) ka khaaka banayein jo AI, IoT ya Cloud se kisi haqeeqi masle ko hal kare.

blocks.prompt: Nayi application design karne ke pehle do qadam kaun se hain? Aik misal dein.
blocks.explanation: Pehle asal duniya ka masla pehchanein, phir us ke hal ke liye sahi tools ka combination chunein. Misal: intelligent tutoring ke liye AI, smart city ke liye IoT, mehfooz data access ke liye Cloud, records ki tasdeeq ke liye Blockchain.

items: Design ka aaghaz asal masle se; sahi technologies ka combination.
Design thinking: user ko markaz bana kar maqami halat ke mutabiq hal.
